import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1;
    static long mod;
    static long[] fact, finv, invs;
    static final int VMAX = 10010;

    static long modPow(long a, long n) {
        long res = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) res = res * a % mod;
            a = a * a % mod;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long modInv(long a) {
        return modPow(a, mod - 2);
    }

    static void initFact() {
        fact = new long[VMAX];
        finv = new long[VMAX];
        invs = new long[VMAX];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < VMAX; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        finv[VMAX - 1] = modInv(fact[VMAX - 1]);
        for (int i = VMAX - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            finv[i] = finv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
        }
        for (int i = VMAX - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            invs[i] = finv[i] * fact[i - 1] % mod;
        }
    }

    static long choose(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * finv[n - k] % mod * finv[k] % mod;
    }

    static long binom(int a, int b) {
        return fact[a + b] * finv[a] % mod * finv[b] % mod;
    }

    static long catalan(int n) {
        long res = binom(n, n);
        if (n - 1 >= 0) {
            res = (res - binom(n - 1, n + 1) + mod) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextLong();
        sc.close();

        initFact();

        long ans = 0;
        for (int len = 1; len < m; len++) {
            long f = modPow(len + 1, len) * len % mod * modInv(n - len) % mod * finv[len] % mod;
            for (int i = 0; i < m - len; i++) {
                int j = i + len;
                long g = modPow(n - len, i) * finv[i] % mod;
                long h = (n - j) * modPow(n + 1, m - 1 - j) % mod * fact[j] % mod;
                ans = (ans + f * g % mod * h) % mod;
            }
        }
        ans = ans * modPow(2, m - 1) % mod * (n + 1 - m) % mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
